paragraphs.text: The Uktabi (ook-tah-bee ) is a small jungle south of the Teremko Mountains and the vast Mwonvuli Jungle , located east of Ufunguo on Zhalfir .

Like all of Zhalfir , the Uktabi Jungle used to belong to the continent of Jamuraa on the plane of Dominaria . Ever since Mangara came to Zhalfir and set up diplomatic relations with the nations of Jamuraa, the Uktabi had been the domain of his allies, the Quirion elves . They colonized much of the forest, and their indomitable city of Salamzuri stood as its capital and as a beacon of sanctuary for refugees.
During the time of the Mirage War , the jungle had a Maro-Sorcerer .
Uktabi was phased out with the rest of Zhalfir and now exists as part of that separate plane.
